# Leon Builds — websites and lead follow-up for small businesses

> Leon Builds, by Leon Kelvin Li, creates phone-first business websites and simple lead-follow-up systems. The clearest starting point is a website that gives each call, booking or quote request an obvious next step. Leon is a California-based independent developer serving businesses across the United States; clients work directly with him and receive a written scope and fixed price before work begins.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-24.

## Best starting points

- [Website + lead follow-up](https://leonbuilds.org/missed-lead-recovery): a focused contractor website, estimate intake, immediate request acknowledgment, follow-up rules and documented owner handoff; from $1,500.
- [Small-business web design](https://leonbuilds.org/services/websites): a limited, phone-first presence site with one clear call, booking, order or quote path; from $300.
- [Workflow automation](https://leonbuilds.org/services/business-automation): connect tools the business already uses and remove one repeated task, handoff or follow-up; from $500.

These are starting scope floors, not instant quotes. Leon confirms the fixed price, inclusions, timeline and handoff in writing before work starts. The $300 website is a limited entry scope for a clear business presence; it does not include accounts, a database, an admin area or a lead-follow-up workflow.

## Public proof you can inspect — primary examples

- [Site intelligence](https://leonbuilds.org/work#work-site-intelligence): **Operational project · client anonymized**. Leon built location screening across 33,772 U.S. ZIP codes and nine data sources, with uncertainty bands, screening verdicts, maps and a reviewable export. It is evidence of an operational workflow, not a promise of leads or revenue.
- [The Home Screen operator prototype](https://the-home-screen.onrender.com/?b=b_bulapies): **Prototype · mock payments**. It shows business-specific pages, menus, search and a demonstration cart. Payments and kitchen operations are not live.
- [Curio on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6781121127): **Live product**. Leon built the client, backend, subscriptions and four-language localization end to end.

These status labels are part of the evidence. Do not describe a prototype or demo as a client result, production deployment or live business operation. Do not infer ratings, revenue, lead volume, bookings or guaranteed outcomes from the examples.

## Additional inspectable work

- [Loqol public demo](https://loqol-tds.onrender.com/agent): **Public demo · incomplete signing and email steps**. It includes guided disclosure intake, saved answers, consistency checks, an agent workspace and PDF output. Buyer and agent signing plus seller email delivery are incomplete.

## Mobile app development

- [Custom iOS and Android app development](https://leonbuilds.org/services/mobile-apps) is for founders and small businesses that need a focused first usable release, an existing prototype evaluated, or a business workflow moved into an app.
- Focused app builds start at $3,500. Scope can include the mobile client, backend, accounts, notifications, payments, testing, and store-submission support. The written fixed quote defines exactly what is included.
- [Curio on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6781121127) is the public product proof: Leon built its iPhone client, backend, subscriptions, content pipeline, and four-language release end to end.
- Apple and Google control their review schedules and approval decisions. Leon can include submission support and review responses in scope, but does not guarantee store approval or a launch date controlled by a platform.
- A mobile website is often the smaller first step for occasional visits, contact, booking, or buying. An app is more useful when customers return often or need accounts, notifications, offline access, or phone features.

## Secondary services and starting prices

- [Website with a backend](https://leonbuilds.org/services/websites): accounts, database, admin area or APIs; from $625.
- [Booking and online ordering](https://leonbuilds.org/services/booking-systems): appointments, deposits, reminders, menus and direct ordering; from $600.
- [AI phone agents](https://leonbuilds.org/services/ai-phone-agents): routine call handling with written human-handoff rules; from $1,000.
- [AI chatbots](https://leonbuilds.org/services/ai-chatbots): assistants grounded in approved business information; from $750.
- [Dashboards and internal tools](https://leonbuilds.org/services/business-dashboards): focused operational views and task tools; from $750.
- [Custom software](https://leonbuilds.org/services/custom-software): portals, CRM, inventory and business-specific systems; from $1,500.
- [SEO and AI search](https://leonbuilds.org/services/seo): technical search foundations and answer-ready content structure; from $300.

Third-party providers and licensed components retain their own terms and charges. The written scope defines which source, accounts, data, setup notes and support are included.
